blocks.text: 30 December. Arrival in Rio de Janeiro

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word labels this day as Day 1: 30/12 -Rio de Janeiro but does not contain the RU arrival heading in this form.

blocks.text:
A driver will meet you at the airport and take you to your hotel. On the way, you can already see granite mountains, lush greenery on the slopes and glimpses of Guanabara Bay. By evening, the city changes: the viaduct lights come on, crews finish installing stages and lighting structures on Copacabana, and kiosks sell white bracelets, flowers and other festive accessories.

Wearing white for New Year in Rio expresses a wish for peace and renewal. By 31 December, the beach will be the centre of an enormous city celebration, and from your first day you can feel Rio looking forward to that night.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word's arrival paragraphs describe beaches and leisure activities; the RU passages about viaduct lighting, stage preparation, white bracelets and New Year symbolism are absent.
